title: Words to read and colour: Shaddah with the Name Allah and sun letters
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: At-Takathur, Al-Qari'ah, madd letters and shaddah
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 36 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 36. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Shaddah with the Name Allah and sun letters). Then trace and copy.

panels.title: Shaddah in the Name Allah
points: ٱللَّه: the laam has a shaddah

questions.a: an-na'iim: the laam is quiet, the noon is doubled.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: read six al- words and colour the shaddah ones yellow. The teacher listens to today's group.
questions.a: Six words read; sun-letter words coloured.

questions.q: Extend: say 'Allah' slowly and hear the double laam.

questions.a: A) quiet: an-naas. The ن has a shaddah: it is a sun letter, so the laam is quiet.

questions.q: The Name Allah has a shaddah on ...
Think again: We say 'Allah' many times a day. Can you hear the double laam in it?
questions.a: Yes: Al-laah. The laam has a shaddah.
